						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_china_decision_soviet_assistance_offer_pending
						COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_eligible = yes
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_china_soviet_reward_applied
						SOV = { exists = yes }
						NOT = { has_war_with = SOV }
						has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					tag = SOV
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_china_decision_soviet_assistance_inbox
					NOT = {
						tag = SOV
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_china_decision_soviet_assistance_inbox
						VIE = {
							COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_eligible = yes
							has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_china_decision_soviet_assistance_offer_pending
							COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_eligible = yes
							has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_china_soviet_reward_applied
							SOV = { exists = yes }
							NOT = { has_war_with = SOV }
							has_global_flag = mdcw_cw_initialized
						}
					}
				}
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_china_decision_soviet_assistance_inbox
				VIE = {
					clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_china_decision_soviet_assistance_offer_pending
					clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_china_decision_soviet_assistance_awaiting_response
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_china_decision_soviet_assistance_refused
					set_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_soviet_response
					country_event = { id = COLDWAR_VIE_CAMPAIGN.135 }
				}
			}
		}
		ai_chance = { factor = 1 }
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_event_136_option_3
		trigger = {
			NOT = { tag = SOV has_country_flag = COLDWAR_VIE_china_decision_soviet_assistance_inbox }
		}
		ai_chance = { factor = 1 }
	}
}
